paragraphs.text: Gorra Tash and Silas are a pair of criminals from Tarkir who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where they have a bounty outstanding.

Gorra Tash and Silas are infamous outlaws whose exploits have made them well-known figures in Thunder Junction . They gained notoriety for their criminal activities, which have earned them a substantial bounty .

Standing out due to his towering height and robust build, Gorra Tash presents a human appearance with a rounded head and ears. His intimidating presence is enhanced by his Hellspurs attire, which includes rugged clothing imbued with flames and equipped with charged thundercasters. This attire signifies his affiliation with the Hellspurs gang and their penchant for fire and thunder magic.

In contrast, Silas bears the distinct features of a Tarkir goblin . His curved nose, sloping forehead, prominent cheekbones, sharp ears, and bushy eyebrows make him easily recognizable. Like Gorra Tash, Silas is also clad in Hellspurs clothing, complete with rugged, flame-adorned gear and charged thundercasters. This attire underscores his alignment with the Hellspurs and his role in their fiery, destructive escapades.
